messages:
sam: Heads-up: planning to deprecate the internal multiplexing API v1 used by client SDKs next quarter. Will break the combined-request path. Need migration plan for SDKs and console mapping. TL;DR: switch to explicit batch endpoints or per-request multiplex headers.

jules: wait, is this the same mux API that lets mobile send 5 requests in one tcp frame? we've relied on that to hit latency/cost SLOs

sam: yes. It was a perf hack that complicates quota attribution and console telemetry. It lumps tokens and attribution across tenants. We're seeing wrong tenant attribution on ~0.8% of requests.

kevin: can we do a shim in the proxy that expands mux -> individual requests and preserves original metadata? that'd avoid breaking SDK consumers

mira: we prototyped a shim last month. Works but introduces an extra serialization step and adds ~6-8ms p95 overhead. Also confuses console because trace ids change.

priya: console folks: if we can't keep trace continuity, dashboards will show duped spans and misattributed latency. We need a mapping plan for rollout window.

sam: proposal: phased deprecation
1) announce + opt-in shim flag for 3 months
2) default shim off, SDKs get 2 minor releases with warning logs
3) remove mux path after 90 days

jules: ok timeline makes sense. For SDKs, what's the code change surface? Python/TS/Go likely need API rename or header change?

kevin: small change: SDKs will send `X-Redwood-Batch` with per-item metadata. Current mux uses `x-rw-mux-v1` with packed payload. We'll accept both for 2 releases but log a deprecation warning.

mira: telemetry: we can add an `X-Original-Trace` passthrough to keep trace id, but the shim currently rewrites traces. If proxy just forwards trace header intact, a lot of issues go away.

priya: console: we need a migration notice and a temporary UI toggle to group by `original_trace` for 6 weeks. Also need to surface quota breaks per-item. I'll create a dashboard card

sam: action items:
- @kevin: prepare SDK PRs (py/ts/go) with opt-in toggle and warning logs
- @mira: triage shim performance and implement `X-Original-Trace` passthrough
- @priya: draft console migration UX + dashboard grouping
- @jules: run canary tests with heavy batching workloads

kevin: starting SDK PRs today. plan: release patch with flag `enable_mux_v1_shim=true` then minor that flips default to false + warning. timeline ~3 weeks.

jules: I'll coordinate e2e perf runs. Can someone stash a representative trace set? we need to reproduce misattribution.

mira: @jules added link to prototype logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/mux-proto-2026

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: mux-shim-stage -> staging at 6654321205

priya: thanks. I'll put a banner in Console (deprecation notice) and track adoption metrics (header presence, shim usage) in the rollout board.

sam: cool. We'll sync in eng-platform weekly until removal. If anyone hits critical blockers ping me in #release-war-room :rocket:

kevin: note: need to update changelogs and migration snippet in quickstarts. Example client code change:

```
// before
client.sendMux([{input: 'a'}, {input: 'b'}])

// after
client.batchRequests([{input:'a'},{input:'b'}], {metadataPerItem: [...]})
```

jules: minor nit: ensure SDKs keep binary compat where possible. no forced major bumps.

sam: agreed. keep semver minor. ok that's it.
